subject: Promote GitHub Actions into a typed GitHubActionTwin evidence organ

body.goal: Treat GitHub Actions as a ForeignTwin/ProcessOccurrence source whose evidence participates in WorkGraph, FactorValidityEnvelope, ProofFrontier, ResourceGraph, and ContextCompiler rather than as a boolean CI badge.
hard_rules: CI success is evidence for the tested factor set, never semantic completion or authority.
action_required is workflow admission/approval state and must not count as code failure.
skipped_by_contract is neither pass nor fail; preserve the skip predicate.
No-run returned by a partial API is visibility_unknown unless an exhaustive source proves absence.
A green dependent run becomes green_but_factor_stale when a bound semantic dependency changes.
A rerun attempt is a distinct ProcessOccurrence but may satisfy the same WorkGraph obligation.
After orthogonal jobs are green, rerun only the invalid failing factor when GitHub supports a bounded retry; do not spend full-matrix compute by default.
Workflow-definition identity and immutable action SHAs are producer-definition evidence and must bind the run before its result is promoted.
Artifacts belong in ObjectFabric by digest; raw logs remain bounded/hashed and are not authority.
Current green receipts should become ProofFrontier capsules so ContextCompiler can reuse them instead of scheduling local rediscovery.
live_fixtures: deepeval#3056 ca677d5: six PR workflows green = success_current
deepeval#3064 a0ac51b: workflows green but embedded alignment seam predates current #3056 2-D resync = green_but_factor_stale
agentguard#214 old upstream workflow state action_required while owned validation exposed a real Python-3.12 runtime divergence
agentguard#214 focused repair promoted production head d5c85dd only after exact rebase + Python 3.9 + Python 3.12 + Ruff + diff-check
bernstein validation 5f485911: CI/policy/security/docs lanes green; non-opt-in workflows skipped_by_contract
bonfyre third-trajectory: push-triggered runs exist in notification evidence while PR-only commit-run helper returns none = visibility_unknown through that adapter
execution_demand: Implement the smallest native/control-plane GitHubActionTwin projection that can ingest these fixtures without network mutation.
Add hostile tests for stale-green dependency factors, action_required misclassification, skipped-as-success laundering, and partial-API no-run laundering.
Connect ActionRunOccurrence to ProviderGraph/Partner Commons only as observation; it grants no effect authority.
Expose a cheapest-valid-next-proof recommendation so WorkGraph can choose one failed job, one full replay, no replay, or dependency invalidation based on the evidence state.
Return a receipt with classification fixtures and at least one replay showing avoided redundant CI/local work.
